scope: Bounded real Store and native Python thread lifecycle test; no worker or IFC verdict
initial_failure: shutdown joined an owned thread before Thread.start and raised RuntimeError
correction: Thread registry publication and Thread.start share the shutdown snapshot lock; closed scheduling cancels before startup; failed thread starts clean up the registry.
checked_cases: Concurrent shutdown waits for delayed startup, then cancels the run and joins the actual supervisor without launching a child.
A queued run scheduled after service closing starts neither a thread nor a job.
Thread.start RuntimeError persists FAILED and removes the unstarted thread, leaving shutdown usable.
